name: Video Watermark Remover
intro: Welcome to the Video Watermark Remover in SmartVideo. This intro page explains how removal works, then sends you to Video Studio to clean up your own footage.

features.remove-watermarks-free-button: The Remove Watermarks Free button under the title is your main starting point. It opens Video Studio, where the removal actually happens.
features.powerful-removal-tools-section: The Powerful Removal Tools cards give a quick summary of what the remover is for. They're information only, so just skim them.
features.how-it-works-steps: How It Works breaks the process into three simple steps: upload your video, let the AI process it, then download. It's a handy preview before you begin.
features.ai-video-watermark-remover-card: In Available Tools, the Watermark card opens Video Studio. The right model is chosen for you automatically when you upload a video there.
features.ai-video-object-remover-and-logo-remover: The object remover and logo remover cards also open Video Studio. They're handy shortcuts when you want to clear unwanted elements or branding from a clip.
features.removing-a-watermark-in-video-studio: In Video Studio, the video button next to the prompt uploads your clip. The studio switches to the watermark remover model, and no prompt is needed.

outro: Only remove watermarks from footage you own or are licensed to edit. Keep the original, and you're all set.
